title: 座位预约管理系统
summary: 管理编号 1..n 的座位，预约时返回最小未预约编号，退订指定已预约座位。
insight: 把所有可用座位放入小根堆；reserve 弹出堆顶，unreserve 把编号重新放回。
pitfalls: 保证退订的是已预约座位
每次预约必须取当前最小编号

solutions.title: 可用座位小根堆
solutions.idea: 堆顶始终是最小可预约座位。
steps: 构造时把 1..n 全部入堆

code.java: class SeatManager { PriorityQueue<Integer> available=new PriorityQueue<>();public SeatManager(int n){for(int seat=1;seat<=n;seat++)available.offer(seat);}public int reserve(){return available.poll();}public void unreserve(int seatNumber){available.offer(seatNumber);} }
code.kotlin: class SeatManager(n:Int) { private val available=java.util.PriorityQueue<Int>();init{for(seat in 1..n)available.add(seat)};fun reserve():Int=available.remove();fun unreserve(seatNumber:Int){available.add(seatNumber)} }
code.cpp: class SeatManager { priority_queue<int,vector<int>,greater<int>> available;public:SeatManager(int n){for(int seat=1;seat<=n;++seat)available.push(seat);}int reserve(){int seat=available.top();available.pop();return seat;}void unreserve(int seatNumber){available.push(seatNumber);} };
